title: Sierre-Zinal — winners since 1974
claims: The page presents a list of all winners since the first edition of the race in 1974.
The list gives the 2024 men's winner as Kilian Jornet (ESP) in 2:25:34 and the 2025 men's winner as Philemon Kiriago (KEN) in 2:28:31.
The list gives the 2024 women's winner as Joyline Chepngeno (KEN) in 2:54:06 and the 2025 women's winner as Caroline Kimutai (KEN) in 2:55:31.
The list gives the 2023 men's winner as Philemon Kiriago (KEN) in 2:27:27 and the 2023 women's winner as Sophia Laukli (USA) in 2:53:17.
The list gives the 1996 men's winner as Eticha Tesfaye (ETH) in 2:41:05 and the 2003 women's winner as Tsige Worku (ETH) in 3:16:07.
The list gives the 2017 and 2018 women's winners as Lucy Wambui Murigi (KEN) in 2:58:40 and 2:57:54.
A footnote states that times from the 2020 and 2021 editions are not officially recognised due to course changes and exceptional race conditions.
The list records Maude Mathys (SUI) winning in 2:46:03 in 2021, a time covered by the footnote excluding 2020 and 2021.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网冠军表。表格为逐年滚动布局，页面顶部先列 2025 与 2024；本页按年份字段逐条抄录，未把 2026 届写入该表，2026 届成绩另引世界田联与 GTWS。
